citation: Mackay, E. J. H. 1938. Further Excavations at Mohenjo-daro: Being an Official Account of Archaeological Excavations at Mohenjo-daro Carried Out by the Government of India between the Years 1927 and 1931. 2 vols. (Vol. I Text; Vol. II Plates). New Delhi: Manager of Publications / Government of India. With chapters by A. S. Hemmy, B. S. Guha, and P. C. Basu.
notes: Primary official ASI report for Mohenjo-daro seasons 1927–1931, complementing Marshall 1931 (1922–1927). JRAS review metadata: Vol. I xvi+718 pp.; Vol. II plates. Digitized IGNCA/ASI copies on Internet Archive (accessed 2026-10-11). Historical P-tier: 1930s absolute chronology and interpretive labels outdated — use for architecture, wells/drains, seals, and find contexts; cross-check dates with modern secondary syntheses.

editorial.notes: Copied from source registry front matter; no new bibliographic claims.
